description: Authoritative instrument-to-color catalog used by the core row, wheel and drawing.

notes.color: Opaque #RRGGBB cell fill shown in inlineInstrumentWheel.
notes.packId: core identifies 17 bundled presets; full identifies 257 additional presets, including Flute. Once downloaded, the full bank replaces core for all 274 presets.
notes.editing: Edit each instrument color here. The metadata refresh script preserves colors and labels. Enum IDs and bank/program mappings must remain consistent with the application catalog.
notes.indices: bank, program, soundFontIndex, row and column are zero-based.
notes.usage: Runtime source of instrument colors and core membership, parsed once and shared by the row, wheel, drawing and completed-stroke renderer.
